issues.display_title: Issue #1674: fix(ads): add missing app keys to EXCLUDED_IMAGES_BY_APP
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

GetBannerAdsAction was missing other and mapthru as keys in EXCLUDED_IMAGES_BY_APP. Any banner ad lookup for those apps would fail to find a matching key, potentially causing unintended behavior when filtering excluded images.

Change

Added other and mapthru to the EXCLUDED_IMAGES_BY_APP constant with empty exclusion lists, consistent with gonav and photostudio.

File: app/Actions/Ads/GetBannerAdsAction.php

issues.display_title: Issue #1669: Enhancement: POST /tours/{mid}/ai-blur to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap `POST /tours/{mid}/ai-blur` to the strict Domain-Based ADR pattern.

Scope:

  • Controller method: `BlurController@aiBlur`
  • Legacy action: `app/Http/Controllers/Tours/Blur/Action/AIBlur.php`
  • Add DTO, Repository, ExceptionMapper, and standard response envelope as needed.
  • Preserve existing request/response behavior while moving the endpoint to ADR conformance.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1671 (feature/issue-1669-ai-blur-adr, merged into main).

  • New AIBlurController / AIBlurAction / AIBlurDto / AIBlurQueueService, replacing legacy BlurController@aiBlur. Legacy action class (app/Http/Controllers/Tours/Blur/Action/AIBlur.php) preserved (not deleted; still used by other flows).
  • TokenRepository extended with getActiveAIBlurTokensByUsageType and getUnusedTokensForAIBlur; UserRepository extended with getFreeAIBlurBudget.
  • Token allocation: free credits (free_ai_blur) consumed first per pano; paid tokens drawn from active ai_in_used rows first (oldest first), then notused rows. both type costs 2 paid credits per pano.
  • Route updated: Tours\Blur\BlurController@aiBlur → Tours\AIBlurController@handle.
  • Response contract preserved: success returns 200 with empty data array.
domainCode HTTP Condition
TOURS.USER_NOT_AGREE 409 user_agree is false or missing
TOURS.VALIDATION_FAILED 409 panos empty, moderation_id is 0, or type not plate/face/both
TOURS.INVALID_PANORAMA 409 none of the submitted pano IDs belong to the moderation
TOURS.TOKENS_NOT_ENOUGH 409 insufficient paid token capacity for the requested panos

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path
POST /tours/ai-blur

issues.display_title: Issue #1670: Enhancement: POST /panoramas/{mid}/blur to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap `POST /panoramas/{mid}/blur` to the strict Domain-Based ADR pattern.

Scope:

  • Controller method: `PanoramasController@blurPanorama`
  • Legacy action: inline logic inside `PanoramasController` (~50 lines)
  • Add DTO, Repository, ExceptionMapper, and standard response envelope as needed.
  • Preserve existing request/response behavior while moving the endpoint to ADR conformance.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1672 (feature/issue-1670-panorama-blur-adr, merged into main).

  • New BlurPanoramaController / BlurPanoramaAction / BlurPanoramaDto, replacing legacy PanoramasController@blurPanorama.
  • PanoramaRepository extended with getPanoIdsWithBlurRegions (distinct pano IDs from 8_blooring).
  • Route moved from non-auth group to middleware=auth group (token check now in middleware, not manual check) and updated: PanoramasController@blurPanorama → Tours\BlurPanoramaController@handle.
  • Succeeds silently (200) when no blur regions exist — nothing queued to RabbitMQ.
  • Response contract preserved: success returns 200 with empty data array.
domainCode HTTP Condition
TOURS.VALIDATION_FAILED 409 moderation_id is 0
TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_OWNER 409 authenticated user does not own the moderation
TOURS.BLUR_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE 503 RabbitMQ broker unreachable

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path
POST /panoramas/blur
